claims: On the pinned executable, the guarded CNT tag QWC spans exactly the bytes after its 16-byte DMA tag up to the immediately following END tag: 782 qwords for the first chain and 70 qwords for the second.
The bounded parser interprets MPG NUM=0 as 256 VU instruction pairs, and interprets MPG IMM as an instruction index whose VU byte address is IMM multiplied by eight.

The verified first chain conditionally maps seven payloads to the first seven overlay source spans, and the second chain maps one payload to the eighth overlay source span; all eight byte spans match exactly with no unmatched overlay or extra MPG.
The raw caller, helper, and DMA pointer-table guards support a conditional static mapping of the seven-chunk chain to VIF1 and the one-chunk chain to VIF0, if those routines execute.
The parser accepts REF DMA tags and DIRECT VIF commands.
The static byte checks prove that the DMA transfers occurred at runtime and establish rendered geometry semantics.

evidence.text: Pinned source .scratch/mesh/codex-root/binutils-dvp/gas/config/tc-dvp.c: vif_insn_len decodes MPG when (cmd & 0x70)==0x40, sets DVP_VUUP, reads NUM from bits 16..23, and returns 1+(NUM==0?256:NUM)*2 32-bit words. opcodes/dvp-opc.c extract_vif_datalen reads MPG NUM from bits 16..23 and returns 256 for zero. Therefore command-word count is VU instruction pairs and each payload pair is 8 bytes. The verifier rejects every DMA tag other than CNT at chain start and END at the exact body boundary; it rejects VIF commands other than exact NOP and MPG.

Verifier binds to executable SHA-256 216711210898aee296eed73d0776e7f733bac04c334002683bce769c86beea95. It compares exact raw function instruction byte sequences for 0022fd48, 00114fe0, 001f4138, 001f4468, 001f40d8 and compares pointer table 0024d0b8 words [10008000,10009000]. Raw caller instructions pass arg index 1/packet 00217be0 and index 0/packet 0021ace0. Helper instructions are pinned and preserve TTE bit 0x40 while setting CHCR 0x105, TADR+0x30 and QWC zero at +0x20; f40d8 does not transform these non-SPR packet addresses. Output status pass: overlay_count=8, transfer_count=8, matched_count=8, unmatched_overlay_count=0, total_instruction_pairs=1698, total_transferred_bytes=13584. Seven matches label VIF1 and one VIF0. Every match checks exact payload bytes against data[parse_overlays.source_offset:source_offset+bytes], as well as ELF VA mapping and SHA-256. Claim limits explicitly exclude runtime execution, scheduling, geometry semantics, and rendered output.

PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest test_ps2_vif test_ps2_vu test_ps2_executables -v: 22 tests passed. Negative controls cover wrong executable identity, TTE disabled, non-CNT tag, IRQ flag, nonzero CNT address, unsupported VIF command, VIF interrupt flag, malformed QWC, unsupported END payload, out-of-range MPG destination, and MPG payload overrun. The pinned executable fixture verifies all 8 exact matches and no extras.
